# Colin Bamforth

> Author of paramedic thrillers, science-backed stress-management guides and children's books, written by a paramedic with nearly 40 years on the front line in New Zealand, Australia and the UK.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://colinbamforth.com/): author profile, current books and book news.

## Books

- Overwhelmed by Stress? series: science-backed stress-management guides.
- Shift-Worker Stress Workbook: sleep, decompression and family-life workbook for emergency services and other shift workers (ISBN 978-1067315429).
- Paramedic thrillers and children's books: see the homepage for the current list.
